byang sa nas gsungs pa'i sdom ldan de la/ bslab btus nas gsungs pa'i rtsa ba'i ltung bar bshad pa bcu dgu po thams cad sdom pa gtong ba'i rgyur mi 'gyur ram snyam pa'i dogs pa de ni/ gzhung 'di'i rnam bshad mdzad pa phal che ba la snang zhing*/ rnam bshad mdzad pa ku mā ra la sogs pa la la dag gis/ lugs gnyis kyi rtsa ba'i ltung ba rnams phan tshun du gnyis kas gnyis ka bsdus pa'i bshad pa rang lugs yin pa lta bur gzhag 'dug pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis so// gnyis pa ma dris na gzhung chud 'dza' ba'i nyes dmigs ni/ lugs de gnyis kyi ltung ba la gzhi mthun mi srid na bslab btus dang dngos su 'gal ba dang*/ bslab btus nas gsungs pa'i rtsa ltung thams cad byang sa'i ltung bar bsdus na byang sa nyid dang dngos su 'gal ba dang*/ rtsa ba'i ltung ba phan tshun khyab mnyam du 'chad pa de lta na/ lugs gnyis po phan tshun du bsres nas 'byed pa 'jigs med 'byung gnas la sogs pa'i bzhed pa der song ba dang*/ sems tsam lugs kyi cho ga'i dngos gzhi la/ dbu ma lugs kyi sbyor ba'i cho ga rnams sbyar nas lag len byed pa bod gzhan gyi 'dod pa der song bas bstan bcos 'dis gang bzhag pa'i phyogs snga ma de khas blangs pa yin no// gnyis pa dngos lan gdab pa la gnyis te/ lan dngos dang*/ 'phros pa'i don no// dang po ni/ dbu ma lugs kyi sems skyed kyi sdom pa dang*/ rtsa ba'i ltung ba dang*/ bslab bya sogs kyi nang du gcig shos kyi de dang de dag 'dus pa yin te/ rgya che bas rgya chung ba bsdus pa'i rigs pa las dang*/ dris lan gong ma'i skabs su/ byang sar bshad pa'i pham pa lta bu'i chos bzhi po/ bslab btus kyi rtsa ltung ston pa'i gzhung so so dang sbyor ba'i tshul bshad zin pa de nyid/ bslab btus kyi dgongs pa yin par de nyid kyi lung gis grub pas so// ji ltar zhe na/ de nyid las/ ji skad du/ rtsa ba'i ltung ba 'di dag bde blag tu bzung ba dang*/

'ga' zhig gi lugs gnas par bya ba'i phyir bsdu ba'i tshig le'ur byas pa dag brjod par bya'o// zhes gsungs la/ der 'ga' zhig gi lugs shes pa/ 'phags pa thogs med kyi lugs la bya bar/ sngon gyi bslab btus 'chad pa po kun gyis 'chad kyin snang ba ltar rigs pa'i phyir ro// de ltar bshad pa 'di yang*/ dbu ma'i lugs kyi sems skyed kyi sdom pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbang du byas pa yin gyi/ thams cad la ma yin te/ lugs de la smon pa'i sdom pa rkyang pa blangs nas bsrung ba dang*/ 'jug pa'i sdom pa blangs nas kyang*/ nyes spyod kyi sna gcig sdom pa sogs yod par mdo sde las rgyas par gsungs pa rnams bslab btus su drangs pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa ni/ de ltar na rgya che ba rgya mtsho lta bus/ rgya chung ba lteng ka'i chu lta bu bsdus pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ lugs gnyis kyi ltung ba la gzhi mthun srid kyang*/ rgya chung ba'i nang du rgya che ba rnams ma bsdus pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ lugs gnyis po so so tha dad pa kho nar nges so// zhes bya ba ni bstan bcos mdzad pa po 'di'i bzhed pa yin pa la/ spos khang pa'i rnam bshad las/ thub pa dgongs rgyan du/ 'dir gsungs pa'i rtsa ltung rnams/ byang sar gsungs pa'i rtsa ltung bzhir bsdud pa'i tshul gsal por bshad pa ltar/ sngon gyi slob dpon mang po yang bzhed do// zhes lugs de skyon med yin pa lta bur bshad pa dang*/ ku mā ra'i rnam bshad las/ a bhya ka ras byang sar gsungs pa'i rtsa ltung bzhi po nyid kyis/ nam snying dang thabs la mkhas pa'i mdo nas gsungs pa'i rtsa ltung rnams bsdus par bzhed de/ dgongs rgyan du/ gang zag 'bring dang chung ngu'i bye brag gis/ lnga dang*/ brgyad dang*/ bzhi'o// zhes ltung ba'i rab tu dbye ba rgyas par bstan la/ gang zag gcig la yang gzhan ltung ba de rnams kyang ngo*// zhes rgyal rigs la lnga gsung pa gang zag 'bring dang*/

las dang po pa la brgyad gsungs pa gang zag chung ngu dang*/ byang sar bzhi gsungs pa gang zag chen po'i dbang du byas la/ 'on kyang gang zag de dag re re la yang ltung ba gzhan rnams kyang 'jog par bzhed do// de lta na/ gang zag gsum po re re la ltung ba bcu bdun bcu bdun du 'gyur te/ byang sa'i dang po nam snying gi mdor gsungs pas/ de dang bcas pa'i bcu bzhi/ byang sa'i lhag ma gsum gyi bar pa gnyis dang*/ tha ma'i dam chos ltar snang ston pa ste/ rtsa ba'i ltung ba bcu bdun yod pa'i phyir/ 'o na/ byang sar gsungs pa'i bzhi po nyid kyis gzhan rnams bsdus pas/ bzhir ma bsdus pa'i rtsa ltung gzhan yod par mi 'gyur ro// bsdus tshul la/ sdud byed ni bdag la bstod pa sogs brgyad do// bsdu bya ni theg pa chen po spong ba dang*/ rnyed bkur gyi phyir du bdag la bstod cing*/ gzhan la smod pa ni sdud byed dang gcig pas/ de dag ma gtogs pa'i nam snying gi mdo nas 'byung ba rnams dang*/ thabs la mkhas pa'i mdo nas gsungs pa'i byang chub kyi sems 'dor ba ste/ rtsa ltung bcu bzhi'o// ji ltar bsdus pa'i tshul ni/ so sor thar pa spong ba dang*/ nyan thos kyi theg pas 'dod chags la sogs pa mi spong ba'i 'dzin pa dang*/ zab mo'i don la bzod pa thob ces rdzun du smra ba dang gsum ni/ bdag bstod gzhan smod du 'dus te/ theg chen byang sems rang gi yin pas/ de la bstod cing*/ theg dman la smad pa dang*/ rdzun du smra bas ni/ gang zag rang la bstod cing*/ gzhan la smad pas so// dkon mchog gsum gyi dkor dang*/ chos gos 'phrog pa dang*/ dge sbyong chad pas gcod du 'jug pa sogs gsum dang*/ yang dag 'jog gi longs spyod kha bton pa la ster ba rnams ni/ ser snas nor mi ster bar 'du/ dge 'dun gyi dbyen byed pa dang*/ zhi gnas 'dor du 'jug pa ni/ ser snas chos mi ster bar du/ tshul khrims 'chal pa la rdeg pa sogs dang*/

mtshams med gzhan bzhi dang*/ grong 'joms pa rnams ni sems can la rdeg pas bsdus so// nyan rang gi chos spang ba dang*/ blo ma sbyangs pa la stong pa nyid rjod pa dang*/ byang chub kyi sems spong ba ni/ theg pa chen po spong bas bsdus so// log par lta ba bzung nas/ mi dge ba bcu la rang gzhan 'god pa dang*/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub la zhugs pa bzlog nas theg dman la sbyar ba ni/ dam chos ltar snang ston pa'i nang du 'dus par gsungs so// lung de'i don byang sar gsungs pa bzhi pos/ nam snying gi mdor gsungs pa rnams yin pa'i tshul gyis bsdus pa ni ma yin gyi/ ltung ba ris mthun pa'i tshul gyis bsdus par bzhed pa yin no// zhes gsung bar snang ngo*// 'di mi 'thad pa la gnyis te/ spyir 'jigs med 'byung gnas kyi lugs de mi 'thad/ bye brag tu 'chad lugs de 'dra de bstan bcos 'di'i lugs ma yin pa'o// dang po ni/ bzhi pos dbu ma lugs kyi rtsa ltung thams cad bsdus pa mi 'thad pa dang*/ bye brag tu nam snying gi mdo nas gsungs pa rnams bsdus pa mi 'thad pa yin no// dang po'i shes byed kyang*/ de lta yin pa 'o na/ smon sems btang ba de byang sa'i lugs kyi rtsa ltung du thal bar 'gyur la/ de la 'dod mi nus pa ni/ byang sa las/ smon sems btang ba de sdom pa'i btong rgyu yin kyang*/ rtsa ba'i ltung ba ma yin par bshad pa'i phyir/ smon sems btang ba 'jug sdom gyi rtsa ltung yin na/ smon pa'i sems de 'jug sdom len pa'i dus su blangs par yang ha cang thal bar 'gyur ro// gnyis pa'i shes byed kyang*/ bzhi pos nam snying gi mdo nas gsungs pa mtha' dag bsdus na/ bslab btus nyid dang 'gal ba yin te/ de nyid las/ nam snying gi mdo las gsungs pa bcu bzhi dang*/ thabs la mkhas pa'i mdo nas gsungs pa byang chub kyi sems gtong ba zhes bya ba'i rtsa ba'i ltung ba gcig ste/ bco lnga po sngar bshad zin pa'i 'og tu byang sa'i lugs kyi rtsa ba'i ltung ba gsum po de bshad la/

de yang 'ga' zhig gi lugs gnas pa'i phyir du/ tshigs su bcad pa zhes bya ba de'i don du snang bas so// mdor na bslab btus nas 'byung ba'i rtsa ba'i ltung ba ni gnyis su 'du ste/ mdo nas 'byung ba dang*/ 'ga' zhig gi lugs la gnas pa'o// dang po la/ nam snying gi mdo nas 'byung ba bcu bzhi dang*/ thabs la mkhas pa'i mdo nas 'byung ba gcig go /gnyis pa la bzhi yod kyang gcig nam mkha'i snying po'i mdo'i nang nas 'byung ba de nyid du 'dus pas/ lhag ma gsum bshad pa yin no// gnyis pa ni/ 'jigs med kyi lugs de 'dir btang snyoms su bzhag tu mi rung ste/ lugs de ni gzhung 'dir/ de gnyis lta ba tha dad pas// cho ga yang ni tha dad yin// zhes pa'i dgag bya'i gtso bo yin pa'i phyir dang*/ gangs can pa phyi ma dag gis/ 'jigs med kyi gzhung de tshad ldan gyi khungs su byas nas/ rje btsun sa skya pa'i lugs 'di la bstings par byed pa'i tshig mang du smras pa'i phyir ro// zhar la 'di yang shes dgos te/ ji skad du/ ji ltar nas kyi sa bon ni// grang dro gang du'ang smin pa ltar// de bzhin dbu ma'i sems skyed kyang*// sdig pa yod med kun la skye// zhes sdom min can la'ang sems skyed kyi sdom pa skye bar bshad pa de ni/ smon pa rkyang pa'i sdom pa la dgongs pa yin te/ ji skad du/ rgyal po la gdams pa'i mdo las/ rgyal po chen po 'di ltar/ khyod ni bya ba mang*/ byed pa mang bas/ nyin mtshan du/ sbyin pa nas shes rab kyi bar la bslab par mi nus te/ de bas na rgyal po chen po khyod yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la dad pa dang*/ don du gnyer ba dang*/ smon pa rtag par rgyun du dran par gyis la yid la bsgoms shig gzhan gyi dge ba la rjes su yi rang bar gyis shig rjes su yi rang nas kyang sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ nyan thos dang*/ rang rgyal ba thams cad la phul cig phul nas sems can thams cad dang thun mong du gyis shig

de nas sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi chos yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ba/ nyin gcig bzhin du bla na med pa'i byang chub tu bsngos shig rgyal po chen po/ khyod de ltar byed na/ rgyal srid kyang byed la/ rgyal po'i bya ba yang nyams par mi 'gyur zhing*/ byang chub kyi tshogs kyang yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs pa yin no// byang sa nas gsungs pa'i pham pa lta bu'i chos bzhi pos/ smon pa rkyang pa'i sdom pa 'di gtong ba yang ma yin te/ ji skad du/ byams pa'i rnam par thar pa las/ rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na/ rdo rje rin po che ni chag kyang gser gyi rgyan thams cad zil gyis gnon zhing*/ rdo rje rin po che'i ming yang mi 'dor la/ dbul ba yang rnam par bzlog go /de bzhin du thams cad mkhyen par sems skyed pa'i rdo rje rin po che nan tan dang bral yang*/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi yon tan thams cad zil gyis gnon zhing*/ byang chub sems dpa'i ming yang mi 'dor la/ 'khor ba'i dbul ba thams cad kyang rnam par bzlog go /zhes gsungs so// 'o na 'di tsam zhig sems tsam lugs kyi sdom pa'i rten du yang dgos pa ma yin nam zhe na/ de dgos mod/ de 'dra de sems tsam lugs kyi cho gas thob pa'i sdom pa ma yin pa'i phyir na/ sems tsam lugs kyi sems skyed kyi sdom pa de sdom min can la skye bar thal ba'i nyes pa med do// yang ji skad du/ dper na 'bras kyi sa bon ni// grang ba'i yul du mi skye ba// de bzhin sems tsam pa yi yang*// sems skyed sdig can la mi skye// zhes bshad pa de ni 'jug pa'i sdom pa kho na la dgongs pa yin te/ ji skad du/ lam sgron las/ so sor thar pa ris bdun gyi// rtag tu sdom gzhan ldan pa la// byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa yi// skal pa yod kyi gzhan du min// zhes pa dang*/ byang sa nyid las/ sdom pa 'di len pa'i sngon rol du bar chad 'dri ba na/

rigs kyi bu'am/ chos kyi spun ming 'di zhes bya ba khyod/ byang chub sems dpa' yin nam/ byang chub tu smon lam btab bam/ zhes smros shig des kyang lags so zhes khas long shig ces gsungs pa yin no// //dri ba bzhi pa ni/ dbu ma lugs kyi sems skyed kyi// rten du so thar mi dgos na// yan lag bdun pa sngon 'gro bar// gsungs pa'i dgongs pa gang zhig yin// zhes pa'o// 'di la gnyis las/ dang po la/ 'dri ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ lugs gnyis kyi cho ga'i khyad par/ so sor thar pa rten du dgos mi dgos kyis 'byed pa la rtsod pa mi 'dug kyang*/ rten so sor thar pa de so sor thar pa rigs bdun gang rung la byed na ni/ rje btsun chen po'i gsung rab dang mi mthun pa dang*/ theg chen gyi so sor thar pa la byed na ni/ dbu ma lugs kyi sbyor chog la yan lag bdun pa sngon du 'gro dgos par bshad la/ bdun po'i nang gi bsngo ba de ni rdzogs byang du bsngo ba yin zhing*/ de yang smon pa sems skyed dang don gcig pas/ smon sems kyi dus su ni theg chen gyi so sor thar pa'i sdom pa skye zhing 'thob pa ni/ rje btsun grags pa'i zhabs kyi bzhed pa la snang ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis so// gnyis pa ma dris pa'i skyon ni/ dbu ma'i lugs kyi 'jug sdom gnas pa'i rten du/ nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims nges par dgos pa ma yin no snyam pa 'di/ dus phyis bstan bcos 'di la 'bel gtam byed pa po dag la nges par skye ba yin te/ sdom pa gsum gyi zlas phye ba'i so thar ni/ nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims kyi ming can du gyur pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i so thar la 'chad pa dag snang ba dang*/ gzhung nyid du/ dbu ma lugs kyi sems skyed kyi sdom pa'i rten du so thar mi dgos par yang bshad pas so// de yang de ltar 'dod na ni/ shin tu mi rigs te/ 'jug pa sems skyed kyi sdom pa'i dngos gzhi ni/

nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims la gzhag dgos pa'i phyir dang*/ nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims ni/ sdom pa gsum gyi zlas phye ba'i byang sems kyi sdom pa la 'chad dgos pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa dngos lan gdab pa ni/ dbu ma lugs kyi sems skyed kyi sdom pa ni gnyis te/ smon pa rkyang pa'i sdom pa dang*/ gnyis ka bsdoms pa'i sdom pa'o// dang po'i rten du ni so thar ris bdun lta zhog nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims tsam yang dgos pa ma yin te/ gong du rgyal po la gdams pa'i mdo'i lung drangs pa las/ rgyal po dang shan pa lta bu sdom min can la yang*/ smon pa'i sdom pa skye bar bshad pa las shes so// gnyis pa de'i rten du ni so thar ris bdun po gang rung nges par dgos pa ma yin yang*/ nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims ni nges par dgos te/ de med na 'jug sdom gnas pa'i go skabs med pa'i phyir/ dper na mkhar gzhong la ma rten par/ rgya shug mi gnas pa bzhin no// rten de yang sdom pa'i sngon du len dgos pa yin nam zhe na/ ma yin te/ 'jug pa'i sdom pa len pa'i cho ga de nyid kyis de thob pa yin pa'i phyir ro// sems tsam gyi lugs la ni/ 'jug sdom gyi rten so sor thar pa de nyan thos kyi 'dul ba'i lugs sam/ byang sems kyi 'dul ba'i lugs gang la bya yang 'dra ste/ 'jug sdom gyi sngon du len pa yin la/ de yang rje btsun chen po'i gsung ltar na ni/ 'jug sdom gyi sngon du smon sems len pa'i dus de nyid du smon sems kyi cho gas 'thob par bshad la/ bstan bcos 'di las ni/ thog mar so sor thar pa long*// zhes gsungs pas/ smon sems dang 'jug sdom gyi bar du so thar rigs bdun gang rung len pa'am/ yang na/ smon sems kyi snga rol du bdun po gang rung len pa las ma 'das so// 'di yang 'dod pa'i rten kho na'i dbang du byas pa yin te/ 'phags pa thogs med kyis sems skyed kyi cho ga gsungs pa de nyid/

spyir 'dod khams pa dang*/ bye brag 'dzam bu gling pa'i dbang du byas pa'i cho ga yin pas so// rje btsun gyis/ smon sems kyi dus su byang sems kyi so thar thob par bshad pa yang*/ smon pa dang lhan cig du nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims blangs pa la dgongs pa yin te/ rje btsun nyid kyis mdzad pa'i cho ga las de ltar gsal ba'i phyir// //dri ba lnga pa ni/ rje btsun chen pos rgyun gshags kyi// dus su nyes spyod sdom pa yi// tshul khrims skye zhing de nyid kyang*// so sor thar par bshad ji ci// zhes pa'o// 'di la gnyis las/ dang po dri ba'i bsam pa bslang ba la gnyis las/ dang po 'dri ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ dris lan gong ma'i skabs su dngos lan 'debs pa na/ sems skyed kyi sdom pa lugs gnyis po'i rten du/ so thar gyi sdom pa dgos mi dgos bshad pa'i so thar de/ ris bdun gang rung la byed pa yin pas/ dbu ma'i lugs kyi rten du ris bdun gang rung nges par dgos pa ma yin no// zhes zer ba las 'os mi 'dug pas/ 'o na/ rje btsun chen pos sdom pa nyi shu pa'i rnam bshad du/ sems tsam lugs kyi byang sems sdom pa'i rten du gyur pa'i so thar ngos 'dzin pa na/ 'di skad ces gsungs te/ byang sems kyi so thar blang ba'i cho ga gzhan zhig yod dam/ so thar gyi sdom pa blang ba'i cho ga nyid yin zhe na/ sngar so sor thar pa thob na/ phyis byang sems kyi sdom pa thob pa'i dus su/ sngar gyi de byang chub sems dpa'i sdom par gnas gyur la/ sngar ma thob na/ byang sems kyi smon pa sems skyed kyi dus nyid du byang sems kyi so thar thob pa yin no// zhes gsungs so// ma dris pa'i nyes pa ni/ sems tsam lugs kyi sems skyed kyi sdom pa'i rten du/ so thar ris bdun gang rung nges par dgos na/ rje btsun chen pos/ de'i rten gyi so thar de smon sems kyi cho gas thob par bshad pa dang 'gal lo snyam pa'i dogs pa 'di skye bar 'gyur ro// gnyis pa dngos lan gdab pa ni/

rje btsun gyis de ltar gsungs pa de ni/ byang sems kyi 'jug pa'i sdom pa skye ba dang gnas pa'i rten la dgongs pa yin gyi/ smon sems skye ba dang gnas pa'i rten du dgongs pa ma yin la/ bstan bcos mdzad pa 'dis ni/ so thar ris bdun po sems tsam lugs kyi sems skyed kyi sdom pa skye ba'i rten du 'chad kyi/ gnas pa'i rten du mi 'chad pas/ dgongs pa 'gal ba ma yin no// //dri ba drug pa ni/ so sor thar pa ris bdun po// sems tsam lugs kyi sems skyed kyi// rten du dgos na rje btsun gyis// de dag de yi rten min par// gsungs pa'i dgongs pa gang du btsal// zhes pa'o// 'di la gnyis las/ dang po la 'dri ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ rje btsun gyis/ sdom pa nyi shu pa'i rnam bshad du bshad pa dang*/ bstan bcos mdzad pa po 'dis/ sems skyed pa'i cho gar bshad pa gnyis 'gal ba lta bur bshad pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis so// ma dris pa'i nyes pa ni/ sems tsam lugs kyi sdom pa'i rten du so thar ris bdun gang rung nges par dgos pa de'i tshe/ rje btsun gyis/ sdom pa nyi shu pa'i rnam bshad las/ sdom pa yang dag par blang ba 'di la/ so sor thar pa ris bdun po gang rung rten du dgos sam mi dgos she na/ 'di la kha cig 'thob pa'i rten du dgos kyi/ gnas pa'i rten du mi dgos zer/ kha cig ni/ skye ba dang gnas pa gnyis ka'i rten du mi dgos zer/ gnyis ka ltar yang rigs pa ma yin te/ 'thob pa dang gnas pa gnyis ka'i rten ma yin no// de la dang po 'thob pa'i rten ma yin te/ so sor thar pa ni/ gling gsum gyi skyes pa dang*/ bud med ma yin pa la mi skye la/ byang chub kyi sems ni 'gro ba thams cad la yang skye ste/ mdo las/ lha'i bu la sogs pa so sor thar pa'i snod ma yin pa'ang*/ gang dag byang chub tu sems ma skyed pa de dag ni skyed par bya'o// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ bdud sdig to can bcom ldan 'das kyi drung du byang chub kyi sems skyed pa na/

bcom ldan 'das kyis yongs su dag pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams su/ chos gnang ba thob ces bya bar 'tshang rgya bar lung bstan to// zhes nam mkha' mdzod kyi mdo las gsungs pa'i phyir dang*/ so thar ma blangs pas sems can gyi don du byang chub 'dod pa'i bsam pa skyes pa la/ byang chub kyi sems kyi mtshan nyid yod pa'i phyir ro// byang chub sems pa'i sdom pa gnas pa'i rten du'ang mi rung ste/ so thar shi 'phos pas gtong*/ 'di mi gtong la/ byang chub sems dpa' rab tu byung bas kyang*/ yid kyi gsum ma gtogs pa'i lus ngag gi bdun gzhan don du spyad kyang*/ ltung ba'i gzugs brnyan du gsungs la/ srog gcod la sogs pa ltung ba'i dngos gzhi yan lag tshang bar spyad kyang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa mi 'chor ba'i phyir dang*/ bslab pa kun las btus las kyang*/ so thar gyi sdom pa sngon du song ba'i rab tu byung ba'i phyogs la dgongs te/ ci ste sems can gyi don du 'gyur bar mthong na bslab pa 'bul lo// zhes so thar gyi sdom pa 'bul yang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa yin par gsungs pa dang*/ nye bar 'khor gyis zhus pa las kyang*/ nyan thos kyi sdom pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa'i bsam pa yang gzhan/ sbyor ba yang gzhan yin no// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// zhes pa nas/ 'dir byang sems kyi so thar ni/ sdom pa 'thob pa dang gnas pa gnyis ka'i rten du rung gi snga ma ni de ltar ma yin pas/ rdo rje rtse mo las/ sdom pa gsum la gnas pa ni// dang po'i khrus su bshad pa yin// zhes gang zag gcig gi rgyud la sdom pa gsum ldan par gsungs pa ni/ byang sems kyi so sor thar pa'o// zhes gsungs pa rnams dang 'gal lo snyam pa'i dogs pa 'di/ rtog dpyod dang ldan pa dag la skye bar 'gyur ro// gnyis pa dngos lan gdab pa la gnyis las/ dang po la dngos ni/ lugs gnyis kyi sems skyed kyi sdom pa la/

rten du so sor thar pa dgos mi dgos kyi sgo nas 'byed pa ni/ rje btsun grags pa'i gsung rab na mi gsal zhing*/ chos rje'i gsung rab mtha' dag na gsal bar bzhugs pa yin pa las/ chos kyi rjes/ rje btsun gyi dgongs pa mi mthun par 'chad pa'i go skabs med pa de'i tshe/ 'di ltar bshad dgos te/ rje btsun gyis ni/ sems skyed dang 'jug sdom skye ba dang gnas pa gnyis ka'i rten gyi dbang du byas nas/ ris bdun po de de'i rten du nges par dgos so zhes zer ba 'gog pa yin la/ chos kyi rjes ni/ sems tsam lugs kyi 'jug sdom sngar med skye ba'i rten du/ ris bdun po gang rung dgos zhes 'chad pa yin gyi/ gnas pa'i rten du nges par dgos zhes gsung ba ma yin pa dang*/ rje btsun gyis/ ris bdun po sems skyed skye ba'i rten du nges par dgos pa ma yin zhes gsungs pa de yang*/ spyir sems skyed tsam la dgongs pa yin gyi/ 'jug sdom la dgongs nas bshad pa ma yin te/ smon sems kyi rten du so thar mi dgos shing*/ 'jug sems kyi rten du so thar dgos pa ni/ rje btsun nyid kyi gzhung na gsal ba'i phyir ro// de ltar bshad pa 'o na/ rje btsun gyis ni/ 'jug sdom skye ba dang gnas pa'i rten du nges par dgos pa'i so thar de/ ris bdun po gang rung du mi gtogs pa'i gzhan la gnod pa gzhi bcas spong ba'i tshul khrims shig la bzhed la/ chos kyi rjes ni/ ris bdun gang rung du nges par bzhed pa de nyid las gang bzung*/ gnyis ka ltar yang mi 'gal na ni/ 'gal ba la mi 'khrul par 'gyur te/ rje btsun gyi gsung ltar na ni/ smon sems gang la skye ba de la theg chen gyi so thar skye zhing*/ de nyid 'jug sdom gyi rten du rung ba'i phyir dang*/ lugs phyi ma ltar na/ mi ma yin pa'i 'gro ba pa dang*/ byang gi sgra mi snyan pa ni/ sems tsam lugs kyi 'jug sdom gyi rten du mi rung bar 'chad dgos pa'i phyir/

zhe na/ so thar tsam dang*/ de'i sdom pa ngo bo khyab mi mnyam kyang*/ rten la rgya che chung gi khyad par cher med pa'i tshul 'di ltar/ rje btsun gyis de'i rten du bshad pa'i byang sems kyi so thar de yang*/ mi ma yin pa'i 'gro ba pa dang*/ byang gi sgra mi snyan pa la yod pa ma yin te/ de 'dra de'i ngos 'dzin yang*/ rang bzhin gyi kha na ma tho ba zhes bya ba'i ming can/ mi dge ba bcu spong ba'i sems pa sa bon dang bcas pa smon sems kyis zin pa zhig la zer ba yin la/ de la yang*/ spyir sdom pas bsdus pa dang*/ bar mas bsdus pa gnyis yod cing*/ dang po la/ so thar gyi dang*/ nyes spyod sdom pa dang*/ bsam gtan dang*/ zag med kyi bsdus pa bzhi las/ phyi ma gnyis la ni so sor thar pa zhes zer ba'i go skabs med cing*/ nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims so thar du 'jog pa yang 'dod pa'i rten kho na'i dbang du byas la/ bar mas bsdus pa de yang so sor thar pa ma yin te/ ji srid so thar gyi sdom pa len pa'i sbyor ba'i rig byed skad cig dang po ma skyes pa de srid du/ so sor thar pa tsam du yang mi 'jog par chos mngon pa las bshad pa'i phyir ro// des na rje btsun chen pos/ byang sems kyi so thar 'jug sdom gnas pa'i rten du bshad pa dang*/ smon sems blangs pa'i dus su/ byang sems kyi so thar thob par bshad pa de yang*/ so thar sdom pa'i rten du rung ba'i 'gro ba pa kho na'i dbang du byas pa yin te/ lha'i rten la so thar skye ba dang*/ gnas pa gnyis ka med pa'i phyir ro// gal te so thar tsam dang de'i sdom pa gnyis kyi rten la rgya che chung gi khyad par med pa de lta na/ 'jug sdom gnas pa'i rten du rung mi rung gi khyad par bshad pa ci zhe na/ ji srid 'tsho dang byang chub bar du blangs pa'i khyad par las so// 'o na byang chub bar du blangs pas skye ba'i so sor thar pa zhig khas len nam zhe na/

de ltar khas mi len mod/ nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims so thar sdom pa'i rten rung gi rgyud la ji srid yod pa de srid du so sor thar pa'i ming gis 'dogs la/ rten 'phos pa'i tshe ni nyes spyod sdom pa zhes bya ba'i ming can kho na'o// gnyis pa de las 'phros pa'i don bshad pa ni/ deng sang 'bel ba'i gtam gleng ba 'ga' zhig gi bsam pa la/ ris bdun gang rung du ma gtogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i so sor thar pa ni/ mi ma yin pa dang*/ byang gi sgra mi snyan pa'i rten la yang yod do snyam du sems pa de ni ma shes pa yin te/ dmyal ba pa dang*/ byang gi sgra mi snyan pa la mi dge ba bcu spong ba'i sems pa mngon gyur pa med pa'i phyir dang*/ 'dod pa'i lha dang*/ dud 'gro dang*/ yi dwags la de spong ba'i sems pa bar mas bsdus pa yod kyang sdom pas bsdus pa med pas/ so sor thar par mi 'jog pa'i phyir dang*/ gzugs kyi khams na mi dge ba bcu spong ba'i sems pa sa bon dang bcas pa yod kyang*/ bsam gtan gyis bsdus pas/ so sor thar pa mi rung ba'i phyir dang*/ spyir yang so sor thar pa ni zag bcas dang*/ 'dod pa'i sas bsdus su 'jog pa ni/ chos mngon pa ba dag gi spyi lugs yin pa'i phyir/ 'o na rten de dang dag la nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims kyang med par khas len nam zhe na/ ma yin te/ nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i bsam gtan dang zag med kyi sdom pa yang yod/ bar ma dge ba yang yod pa'i phyir/ 'o na so thar tsam dang*/ ris bdun gang rung gis bsdus pa la khyad par ci zhig yod ce na/ bshad pa/ ris bdun gyi bcas pa'i tshul khrims kyis khyad par du byas pa yin la/ so thar tsam ni rang bzhin gyi kha na ma tho ba las log pas khyad par du byas pa'o// de la'ang sdom pas bsdus ma bsdus gnyis las/ dang po ni/ ris brgyad gang rung gis bsdus pa so thar sdom pa'i ngo bor gyur pa dang*/

nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims kyis bsdus pa byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa'i ngo bor gyur pa dang gnyis so// 'o na gnyis po de'i khyad par ci zhe na/ lus ngag gi spang bya bdun po nyid gtso bor spong ba dang*/ yid kyi mi dge ba gsum gtso bor spong ba'i cha nas bshad pa yin te/ theg pa thun mong gi so thar dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i so thar gyi khyad par ni de nyid du nges pa'i phyir/ de ltar na/ byang chub sems dpa'i so thar yin na sdom pa yin dgos te/ de yin na nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims dang*/ sems skyed kyi sdom pa yin dgos pas so// de ltar na'ang*/ so sor thar pa'i sdom pa yin dgos pa ni ma yin te/ so sor thar pa'i sdom pa la yid kyi mi dge ba gsum spong ba'i sdom pa med pa'i phyir ro// sdom pa de gnyis gang rung gis ma bsdus pa'i mi dge ba bcu spong ba'i tshul khrims ni/ 'dod pa na spyod pa'i tshul khrims yin pa'i cha nas so sor thar pa'i ming gis btags pa srid kyang*/ dngos ma yin te/ sdom pas ma bsdus pa'i phyir/ phyi rol pa'i tshul khrims bzhin no// mdor na/ khams gong ma la sogs pa so thar sdom pa'i rten ma yin pa rnams la/ sems tsam lugs kyi sems skyed kyi sdom pa 'di skye ba'i rten med de/ de'i rten la byang chub sems dpa' khyim pa'am/ rab tu byung ba'i phyogs gnyis po gang rung gis khyab par/ byang sa nyid las bshad pa'i phyir te/ de nyid las/ de la byang chub sems dpa' khyim pa'am/ rab tu byung ba/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa tshul khrims kyi phung po rnam pa gsum po 'di dag la slob par 'dod cing*/ bla na med par yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu smon lam btab pas/ zhes/ sdom pa len pa'i rten gyi gang zag ngos bzung ba'i phyir ro// zhes khas len dgos pa'am/ yang na/ 'jug sdom gyi rten du so sor thar pa nges par dgos pa nyid du bshad pa de ni/

mi'i rten la sdom pa de len pa kho na'i dbang du byas pa yin te/ dbu sems kyi slob dpon so sos mdzad pa'i cho gas zur las de ltar gsal ba'i phyir/ lha lta bu 'gro ba gzhan gyi rten la ni smon pa'i sems dang*/ nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims kyi rten du rung ba tsam gyis 'jug sdom gyi rten du rung bar lta'o// zhes khas blangs na yang lugs gnyis ka dang mi 'gal bar sems so// 'o na 'dod pa'i rten gzhir byas pa la'ang*/ nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims gang yin thams cad so thar du 'jog na ni/ mi ma yin pa dang sgra mi snyan pa la'ang so thar gyi rten du rung bar 'gyur ro snyam na/ skyon med de/ de dag la mi dge ba bcu spong gi sems pa byang chub kyi bar du blangs bas skye srid kyang*/ bar ma tsam las ma 'das pas/ nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims su mi rung ba'i phyir ro// yang skabs 'dir/ dri ba 'di lta bu zhig 'jug ste/ rje btsun gyis ni byang sa yi// 'jug sdom len pa'i snga rol du// smon sems len pa'i cho ga bshad// gzhung 'di'i phyogs sngar mi 'gyur ram// zhes pa 'di'i don ni/ sdom pa nyi shu par/ bla ma sdom la gnas shing mkhas// nus dang ldan las blang bar bya// zhes pa'i rnam bshad du/ bla ma de las blang rgyu'i sems skyed la smon 'jug gnyis su phye nas/ smon pa len pa la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ sbyor ba la gsol ba gdab pa/ tshogs bsag pa/ skyabs 'gro khyad par can bya ba/ gsum du mdzad cing*/ dngos gzhi len pa'i cho ga ni/ jo bo'i gzhung las 'byung ba de nyid drangs nas/ ji skad du/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas/ skye ba 'di dang*/ gzhan dag tu/ sbyin pa las byung ba dang*/ tshul khrims las byung ba dang*/ bsgoms pa las byung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba bgyis pa dang*/

bgyid du btsal ba dang*/ bgyid pa la rjes su yi rang ba des/ ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang*/ sa chen po la bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis/ dang po bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub chen por thugs bskyed pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang*/ dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ sems can ma sgral ba rnams bsgral ba dang*/ ma grol ba rnams dgrol ba dang*/ dbugs ma dbyung ba rnams dbugs dbyung bar bya ba dang*/ yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba'i slad du/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub chen por sems skyed par bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum du dam bca' bar bya'o// rjes kyi bya ba ni/ gtong ba'i rgyu dor ba dang*/ mi nyams pa'i rgyu la bslab pa'o// zhes sogs bshad zin pa'i 'og tu/ 'jug sdom gyi sbyor dngos rjes gsum byang sa las ji ltar 'byung ba de nyid bshad do// 'di ni bstan bcos mdzad pa 'di'i phyogs snga mar 'gyur ba ma yin nam/ ji ltar zhe na/ byang sa nas smon sems len pa'i cho ga dang*/ de'i bslab pa brjod pa sogs ma bshad bzhin du sbyar bas so// de skad du yang*/ glo bo lo tstsha ba'i dris lan las/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa la dbu ma sems tsam gyi dbye ba mi shes par/ sems tsam pa'i lugs la dbu ma'i sdig bshags sogs bsnan nas/ cho ga thams cad dkrugs nas byed// ces dang*/ phyag lo'i dris lan las/ sems tsam pa'i cho ga la sdig bshags sogs dang*/ yul yang skye bo kun la byed na/ byang sa dang mi mthun pas ma dag par mchi/ zhes gsungs la/ de nyid gzhung lugs kyi dgongs pa yin te/ byang sa nyid du yang*/ smon sems la len pa'i cho ga ma gsungs la/ sdom pa nyi shu par yang ma bshad cing*/

de'i 'grel pa byang chub sems dpa' zhi ba 'tshos mdzad par yang de'i cho ga ma bshad/ gnas brtan byang chub bzang pos mdzad pa'i gzhung las kyang*/ 'jug sdom kho na'i cho ga las gzhan ma bshad pas so snyam pa'i dogs pa 'di dpyod ldan la skye bar 'gyur ro// de'i dngos lan ni/ gzhung las smon sems len pa'i cho ga ma gsungs mod/ gang zag las dang po ba 'ga' zhig byang sa'i lugs kyi sems skyed 'di don du gnyer ba byung na/ de smon sems dang so thar gyi sdom pa thog mar 'dzin du 'jug dgos pa yin te/ ji skad du/ gal te sems tsam pa yi yang*// sems skyed sdom pa de 'dod na// thog mar so sor thar pa long*// byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod slobs// zhes sogs 'byung ba ltar ro// 'o na rje btsun gyis/ smon sems kyi 'og tu so thar gyi cho ga ma bshad pa ci zhe na/ de'i lan ni rje btsun nyid kyis bshad zin pa yin te/ ji skad du/ sngar ma thob na ni smon pa sems skyed kyi dus nyid du byang sems kyi so thar thob pa yin no// zhes gsungs so// smon sems kyi dus su so thar thob pa'i go ba yang*/ yan lag bdun pa sngon du song na ni/ sdig bshags kyi dus su phyin chad la sdom sems dgos pas de skye bar rtogs sla ba yin la/ ma song na ni smon sems dang lhan cig tu blangs pa'i dbang du byas pa'o// 'di yang so thar gyi rten du rung ba'i gang zag gi smon sems skyed pa'i dbang du byas pa yin te/ gzhan du na/ gzugs khams kyi rten la so thar skye bar thal bas so// 'jug sdom gyi thog mar smon sems kyi cho ga mdzad pa 'di yang*/ rje btsun gyi rang bzo ma yin te/ jo bo a ti shas mdzad pa'i sems skyed pa dang*/ sdom pa'i cho ga zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos las/ thog mar dkon mchog la mchod pa dang*/ skyabs 'gro khyad par can sngon du btang nas smon sems len pa'i cho ga mdzad cing*/

de'i 'og tu bar chad dris nas/ 'jug sdom len pa'i cho ga byang sa nas ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin mdzad pas so// de dag la 'di skad ces/ sems tsam lugs kyi rang rkang la// smon sems cho ga bshad pa med// dbu ma'i lugs la klu sgrub zhabs// byang chub sems skyed sngar blangs nas// de yi 'og tu sdom pa len// dze ta ri ba smon 'jug gi /sems skyed gnyis po sngar blangs nas// de yi 'og tu sdom pa gnyis// lhan cig len pa spyod 'jug gi /dgongs pa nyid du nges par 'chad// spyod 'jug dngos bstan sems skyed dang*// sdom pa lhan cig len par bshad// dbu ma lugs kyi smon sems dang*// sems tsam lugs kyi 'jug sdom gnyis// len pa'i cho ga rim bzhin du// sbyor mdzad a ti sha yi lugs// gang de'i sbyor ba'i cho ga la// sdig pa bshags pa'ang sbyar byas nas// dbu sems bsres pas 'khrul lo zhes// 'chad pa bstan bcos mdzad 'di'i lugs// sdom pa'i nyi shu'i rnam bshad du// ris bdun rten du mi dgos zhes// bshad pa smon sems dbang du mdzad// 'jug sdom rten du so thar tsam// rung dang ris bdun dgos zhes pa// skye ba'i rten gyi dbang byas na// gnyis po rung khyab mnyam pa la// gnas pa'i rten du snga ma rtsan// so thar gnyis po'i khyad par ni// yid kyi spang bya gsum spong dang*// lus ngag spang bya bdun spong ba// byang chub snying po'i bar dang ni// ji srid 'tsho ba'i khyad de nyid// gnyis ka nyes spyod sdom pa yi// tshul khrims nyid du khyad par med// gcig ni so thar sdom pa dang*// cig shos byang sems sdom pa'o// zhes bya ba 'di yin no// //dri ba bdun pa ni/ don dam sems skyed bya ba yi// cho ga rgyal bas ma gsungs na// byang chub sems 'grel zhes bya ba'i// bstan bcos dag las gsungs de ci// zhes pa 'di la gnyis las// dang po 'dri ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/

ji skad du/ 'di la sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi// cho ga rgyal bas gsungs pa med// ces/ spyir rgyal ba'i gsung rab dang*/ tshad ldan gyi dgongs 'grol dag las/ don dam sems skyed len pa'i cho ga gsungs pa med pa lta bur bshad snang ba dang rnam bshad mdzad pa po dag gis kyang mthun par sgra ji bzhin pa de nyid sor gzhag cing*/ rjes zhes pa la nus pa ma bton par snang ba dang*/ khyad par byang chub sems 'grel gyi lung smos pa ni/ sems 'grel nas bshad pa'i cho ga de/ kun rdzob sems skyed kyi cho ga yin no zhes gsung pa sngon gyi dus su mang po byung snang ba bzhin du/ dus 'dir yang de ltar khas len pa yod dam snyam pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis so// gnyis pa ma dris na bstan bcos chud 'dza' ba'i skyon la gsum ste/ spyir bka' dang bstan bcos dag las de'i cho ga ji ltar gsungs pa'i tshul dang*/ bye brag tu byang chub sems 'grel gyi lung don bsam pa/ bod gzhan gyis brtags pa'i rtog dpyod bsam pa'o// dang po la bzhi ste/ rnam snang mngon byang las gsungs pa dang*/ spang kong phyag rgya pa las gsungs pa dang*/ klu sgrub zhabs kyi rim pa lnga pa las bshad pa dang*/ des mdzad pa'i sems skyed kyi cho ga las gsungs pa'o// dang po la gnyis te/ zhus pa dang*/ lan no// dang po ni/ de nyid las/ bcom ldan 'das/ dus gsum du sgrib pa ma mchis pa'i ye shes kyi sdom pa gang la byang chub sems dpa' rnams gnas na/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams mnyes par 'gyur ba bshad du gsol/ zhes pa'o// lan la gsum ste/ sbyor ba'i tshul gyis kun rdzob kyi dngos po gtong bar sems skyed pa'i sdom pa blang ba/ dngos gzhi'i tshul gyis don dam pa'i de kho na nyid la mnyam par 'jog pa'i sdom pa blang ba/ rjes kyi sgo nas de gnyis ka'i dam tshig rnams 'dzin par bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ ji skad du/ bka' bstsal pa/

rigs kyi bu/ lus dang*/ ngag dang*/ yid lhan cig tu 'jug cing*/ chos thams cad de la rtsol ba med cing*/ bya ba med pa'i sdom pa gang yin pa de nyon cig de gang zhe na/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la bdag nyid yongs su gtong ba gang yin pa de'o// de ci'i phyir zhe na/ gang gis bdag gi lus yongs su btang ba des ni dngos po gsum yongs su btang ba yin te/ dngos po gsum yongs su btang ba gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ lus dang*/ ngag dang*/ yid do// rigs kyi bu de lta bas na/ lus dang*/ ngag dang*/ yid gsum gyi sdom pa bsdam par bya'o// de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni lus dang ngag dang yid gsum yongs su ma btang bar bslab pa 'dzin par mi byed do// zhes gsungs pa 'dis ni/ lus ngag yid gsum gtong dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan bshad nas/ de btang ba'i sdom pa nod pa'i cho ga dngos ni/ ji skad du/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ dus 'di nas bzung ste/ nam byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la bdag nyid dus thams cad du yong ye 'bul gyi/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bdag la thugs brtse ba'i slad du bdag bzhes su gsol/ zhes lan gsum brjod dgos par gsungs so// 'di sdom pa mtshan nyid pa ma yin no snyam du bsam par mi bya ste/ de nyid las/ ji skad du/ de la sdom pa gang zhe na/ bsdams pa ni sdom pa ste/ lus dang*/ ngag dang*/ yid rnams bsdus shing*/ yongs su bsdus pa phyi dang nang gi sdug bsngal sel bar gyur pa de ni sdom pa yin no// zhes gsungs so// gnyis pa ni/ ji skad du/ de bzhin gshegs pa dran byas nas// byang chub sems kyang 'dzin du gzhug /des na rgyal ba'i rigs dge la// thams cad rab tu skyes par 'gyur// zhes gsungs shing*/

de 'dzin du gzhug pa'i tshul ni/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ dus 'di nas zhugs nas/ nam byang chub snying po la 'dug gi bar du/ dngos po thams cad dang bral ba/ phung po dang*/ khams dang*/ skye mched dang*/ gzung ba dang*/ 'dzin pa rnam par spangs pa/ chos bdag med par mnyam pa nyid kyis rang gi sems thog ma nas ma skyes pa/ stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin/ ji ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' de rnams kyis byang chub tu sems bskyed pa de ltar/ bdag gis kyang byang chub tu sems skyed do// zhes lan gsum brjod par gsungs so// gsum pa la/ spyi'i bslab bya dang*/ bye brag slob dpon du 'os pa'i bslab bya gnyis las/ dang po ni/ ji skad du/ de nas slob ma de bslang la/ sngags pa snying rjer gyur pa yis// yid kyi nang du bcug nas ni// de la dam tshig bstan par bya// de ring phan chad khyod kyis ni// dam pa'i chos dang byang chub sems// srog gi phyir yang da phyin chad// yongs su btang bar mi bya'o// khyod kyis ser sna dang ni gang*// sems can gnod pa mi bya'o// dam tshig 'di dag sangs rgyas kyis// brtul zhugs bzang po khyed la bshad// ji ltar bdag gi srog bsrung ba// de ltar khyed kyi 'di dag bsrung*// zhes gsungs pa des ni sdom pa dang po'i dam tshig bstan no// gnyis pa ni/ ji skad du/ ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yi// zhes sogs dang*/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// zhes sogs chos 'chad pa'i rjes su gnang ba gsungs pa rnams kyis ni/ dngos gzhi'i sdom pa bshad ma thag pa de'i dam tshig rnams bstan pa yin no// gnyis pa ni/ spang kong phyag rgya pa zhes bya ba'i mdo las kyang*/ don dam pa'i sems skyed kyi sdom pa nong pa'i cho ga gsal bar gsungs pa yin te/ ji skad du/ dus 'di nas nam byang chub kyi snying po la mchis kyi bar du/

dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi ste/ bdag nyid lus 'bul gyi/ thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa rnams kyis so so nas rtag tu bzhes shig ji ltar na dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dngos po thams cad dang bral ba/ phung po dang*/ khams dang*/ skye mched kyis ma zin pa/ chos thams cad bdag med pa dang mnyam pa/ thog ma med pa nas ma skyes pa/ stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin can gyi byang chub kyi mchog tu thugs bskyed pa ltar/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang*/ dus 'di nas nam byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ byang chub tu sems bskyed par bgyi'o// zhes pa'i cho ga 'di'i sgo nas don dam pa'i byang chub kyi mchog tu sems skyed par gsungs pas so// gsum pa ni/ klu sgrub zhabs kyis/ rim pa lnga pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos las/ ji skad du/ slob ma bzang po skal ldan man ngag thob// thal sbyar lag pa me tog 'dzin pa yis// byang chub sems ni don dam zhes bya ba// bla ma la ni slar yang blang bar bya// dngos po thams cad dang bral ba// phung po khams dang skye mched dang*// gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam spangs pa// chos bdag med pas mnyam nyid pas// rang sems gdod nas ma skyes pas// stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin no// zhes bya ba'o// de nas rang dang rjes mthun yon// bla ma la ni dbul bya ste// rin chen khyim dang glang po rta// yul dang maṇḍal stan dang ni// bran dang bran mo chung ma sdug /gang zhig bdag kyang 'bul byed na// zhes gsal bar gsungs pas/ 'di la ni rjes kyi cho ga yang bshad do// bzhi pa ni/ de la 'di snyam du/ de ltar don dam sems skyed cho gas len par bshad pa de dag ni gsang sngags kyi lugs yin gyi/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa nas don dam sems skyed len pa'i cho ga bshad pa med do zhes bya ba 'di/ thub pa'i dgongs pa gsal ba zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos kyi dgongs pa yin no snyam na/

de yang nges pa med de/ spang kong gi lung drangs ma thag pa dang*/ klu sgrub zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i sems skyed kyi cho ga phar phyin theg pa'i lugs yin par kun la yongs su grags pa de nyid las/ ji skad du/ ji ltar sngon gyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' de dag gis/ dngos po thams cad dang bral ba/ phung po dang*/ khams dang*/ skye mched dang*/ gzung ba dang*/ 'dzin pa rnam par spangs pa/ chos bdag med du mnyam pa nyid kyis/ rang gi sems gzod ma nas ma skyes pa/ stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid kyi byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang*/ dus 'di nas bzung nas/ byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ byang chub tu sems skyed do// zhes gsal bar gsungs shing*/ de'i de ma thag tu/ sems can ma sgral ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi'o// zhes sogs sdom pa 'dzin pa'i cho ga gsal bar gsungs so// kha cig 'di smon sems len pa'i cho ga yin no// zhes zer ba ni ha cang thal ches pa yin te/ sdom bzung gi cho ga des bstan pa'i don la smon pa sems skyed kyi mtshan nyid gang yang ma tshang ba'i phyir ro// der ma zad/ sngags lugs kyi don dam sems skyed cho ga'i sgo nas skye ba yod na brda las byung ba'i sems skyed du thal ba'i rigs pa dang*/ rgyal bas gsungs pa med ces bya ba'i lung dang 'gal ba so na gnas pa ma yin nam/ gnyis pa byang chub sems 'grel gyi lung don bsam pa la/ lung dgod pa dang*/ lung gi don bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ de nyid las/ ji skad du/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de rnams kyis/ ji ltar byang chub chen por thugs bskyed pa de bzhin du/ bdag gis kyang sems can ma rgal ba rnams sgral ba dang*/ ma grol ba rnams dgrol ba dang*/ dbugs ma phyug ba rnams dbugs dbyung ba dang*/ yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba'i phyir/

dus 'di nas bzung ste/ byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du byang chub chen por sems bskyed par bgyi'o// byang chub sems dpa' gsang sngags kyi sgor spyad pa spyod pa rnams kyis/ de ltar kun rdzob kyi rnam pas byang chub kyi sems smon pa'i rang bzhin can bskyed nas/ don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems bsgoms pa'i stobs kyis skyed par bya ba yin te/ de'i phyir de'i rang bzhin bshad par bya'o// byang chub sems kyi bdag nyid dngos// dpal ldan rdo rje bsnams btud nas// byang chub sems kyi sgom pa ni// srid pa 'jig de bdag gis bshad// sangs rgyas rnams kyis byang chub sems// bdag dang phung sogs rnam rig gi /rtog pa rnams kyis ma sgribs shing*// rtag tu stong nyid mtshan nyid bzhed// snying rjes brlan pa'i sems kyis ni// 'bad pas sgom par bya ba yin// zhes gsungs so// gnyis pa la gnyis te/ dngos dang*/ gzhan gyis brtags pa'i mtha' bsal ba'o// dang po ni/ de bzhin du/ skyed par bgyi'o// zhes sbrel bas/ byang chub tu sems skyed pa'i dam bca' gzhag pa'o// bdag gis kyang nas 'da' ba'i phyir// zhes pa'i bar gyis ni de'i sdom pa bzung ba yin no// 'o na sems de skyed pa'i dus der sems de skyes pa yin nam zhe na/ ma yin te/ kun rdzob kyi rnam pas te/ mos pa yid kyi tshul gyis smon pa'i rang bzhin can te/ smon lam gyi rnam pas bskyed nas/ byang chub kyi sems don dam pa de bsgoms pa'i stobs kyis skye bar bya ba yin pa'i phyir/ zhes 'chad pa ni/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes sogs so// 'dir kun rdzob ces pa/ byang chub kyi sems de'i gzugs brnyan dang*/ don dam pa zhes pa/ 'dir bstan gyi byang chub kyi sems dngos de la bya ba yin no// de ltar dam bca'i sgo nas skyed par bya rgyu'i byang chub kyi sems de gang yin zhe na/ 'bras bu'i dus su dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa dngos dang*/

rgyu'i dus su gzung 'dzin gnyis su med pa'i ye shes dang*/ lam gyi dus su snying rje chen po dang*/ des mtshon pa kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems dang zung du 'jug pa'i ye shes so// zhes 'chad pa ni/ byang chub sems kyi bdag nyid dngos// zhes sogs so// de ltar na byang chub kyi sems rdo rje de dam bca'i sgo nas bzung zhing*/ bsgoms pa'i stobs kyis mngon du byed pa ni/ byang chub sems dpa' gsang sngags kyi sgor spyod pa rnams kyi tshul lo// zhes 'chad pa ni/ gsang sngags kyi sgor spyad pa zhes so// de ltar na 'dir bshad pa'i don dam byang chub kyi sems dang*/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa pa dag la grags pa'i don dam sems skyed ces bya ba de don gcig pa ma yin te/ 'dir ni dpal gsang ba 'dus pa las 'byung ba'i byang chub kyi sems rdo rje zhes bya ba de nyid rtsa bar byas nas/ de ji ltar skyed pa dang*/ de skye ba'i thabs su sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims len pa'i cho ga dang*/ byang chub kyi sems de'i ngos 'dzin dang*/ de ngos zin pa'i yan lag tu bdag gnyis 'gog byed kyi rigs pa rgyas par gsungs pa yin la/ phar phyin gyi theg par ni/ don dam sems skyed kyi ngos 'dzin theg chen 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes la bya bar/ theg pa chen po mdo sde'i rgyan dang*/ dbu ma la 'jug pa sogs las bshad pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pani*/ sems 'grel gyi rnam bshad mdzad pa gzhan dag na re/ gzhung 'dir kun rdzob kyi rnam pas// zhes gsungs pas/ spyir kun rdzob sems skyed len pa'i cho ga dang*/ bye brag tu/ smon pa'i rang bzhin can zhes pas/ smon sems kyi cho ga bstan nas/ de'i 'og tu don dam byang sems bsgoms pa'i stobs kyis skye'o// zhes ston pa ni/ don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems bsgoms pa'i stobs kyis skyed par bya ba yin te/

zhes gsungs so// zhes 'chad par byed do// de ni rigs pa ma yin te/ bstan bcos 'di la byang chub sems 'grel zhes mtshan btags pa yin pa las/ des 'grel rgyu'i byang chub kyi sems de gang yin la khyod kyis dpyad pa ma zhugs pa'i phyir dang*/ 'di'i dngos bstan gyi cho ga'i tshig la spyir kun rdzob sems skyed dang*/ bye brag tu smon pa sems skyed len pa'i tshig mi snang ba'i phyir dang*/ sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims kyi cho ga zhig snang yang*/ de tsam gyis kun rdzob sems skyed kyi cho gar 'grub na/ theg chen lugs kyi so thar gyi sdom pa len pa'i cho ga yang der thal ba'i phyir ro// gsum pa ni/ bu ston rin po che'i gsung gis/ don dam sems skyed cho ga'i sgo nas skye ba mi srid na/ dbang bzhi pa'i rtogs pa de dbang bzhi pa'i cho ga las skye ba ma yin par 'gyur ro// zhes gsung par grags so// mdor na don dam sems skyed kyi cho ga bka' dang bstan bcos las gsungs pa med do// zhes pa'i sgra ji bzhin pa 'di nyid la mngon par zhen nas/ rgal zhing brtags pa bzod pa'i grub pa'i mtha' gting tshugs pa'i bshad pa/ gzhung 'di'i rnam bshad mdzad pa po sngon byon pa de dag gis legs par bshad pa ma mthong bas/ dad pa'i rjes 'brang du khas 'che ba dag gis/ bstan bcos chud gsan par gyur pa ma yin nam snyam du bsams nas/ rgal zhing brtag pa'i dri ba de dag bkod pa yin no// de skad du yang*/ gang zhig rtsad cing ma dris pa// de'i bar du gting mi dpogs// rnga la dbyug gus ma bsnun pa// de srid gzhan dang khyad ci yod// ces 'byung ba ltar ro// gnyis pa dngos lan gdab pa la gnyis te/ thub pa'i dgongs gsal las ji ltar 'byung ba'i tshul dang*/ de la dpags nas rang lugs go bde bar bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ de nyid las/ ji skad du/ spyir so sor thar pa'i sdom pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i sems skyed/

gsang sngags kyi dbang bskur rnams cho ga las skye/ bsam gtan gyi sdom pa/ zag pa med pa'i sdom pa/ don dam pa'i sems skyed rnams cho ga las mi skye bar gsungs/ 'o na rnam snang mngon byang las/ yan lag bdun pa'i skabs su don dam pa'i sems skyed kyi tshig lan gsum gsungs pa dang 'gal lo snyam na/ 'di'i lan la/ mgo sgre'i lan dang*/ rnal ma'i lan gnyis so// dang po ni/ khyed kyang phyag rgya chen po sgom med du 'dod na/ de nyid bsdus par/ phyag rgya chen po sgom par bshad pa dang 'gal lo// de nyid bsdus pa rnal 'byor gyi rgyud yin/ der lha'i sku sgom pa la phyag rgya chen por brtags pa yin gyi/ rnal 'byor chen po'i lugs kyi phyag rgya chen po dngos ma yin snyam na/ 'o na rnam snang mngon byang yang spyod pa'i rgyud yin la/ ye shes kyi tshogs sog pa'i sngags la don dam sems skyed kyi ming btags pa yin gyi/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i lugs kyi don dam sems skyed kyi cho ga bshad pa ma yin no// rnam snang mngon byang gsang sngags yin kyang*/ de nyid kyi lugs pha rol phyin pa ba la byas na ci 'gal snyam na/ de nyid bsdus pa yo ga yin kyang*/ lugs de rnal 'byor chen po la ci 'gal/ yo ga dang rnal 'byor chen po rgyud sde tha dad pas/ cho ga dkrugs pa mi 'thad do ce na/ rnam snang mngon byang dang pha rol tu phyin pa'i lugs dkrugs pa'ang ga la 'thad/ gal te theg pa mi 'dra ba'i cho ga 'khrugs kyang*/ mos pa'i sgo nas don dam sems skyed kyi cho ga byas kyang ci 'gal snyam na/ 'o na rgyud sde tha dad kyi lag len 'khrugs kyang*/ yo ga'i lugs kyi phyag rgya chen po rnal 'byor bla med du bsgoms kyang ci 'gal/ phyag rgya chen po sgom du shor ba skyon can yin no// zhe na/ don dam sems skyed cho gar shor ba'ang skyon can yin no// cho gar shor ba ci skyon snyam na/ 'o na sgom du shor ba'ang ci skyon/

sgom rtog pa yin la/ phyag rgya chen po mi rtog pa yin pas 'gal lo zhe na/ 'o na cho ga kun rdzob yin la/ don dam sems skyed don dam yin pas 'gal bar mtshungs so// des na grub mtha' dang rgyud sde'i rim pa mi shes pa'i blun po dag gis/ ming mthun pa tsam la 'khrul gzhir gyur nas/ don gyi gnad ma shes par zad do// gnyis pa dngos po'i lan ni/ spyir chos thams cad la grub mtha'i rnam gzhag dang*/ theg pa'i rim pa gal che/ mtshan nyid pa dang*/ btags pa pa'i bye brag shes dgos/ de'ang grub mtha' la/ nyan thos kyi don dam theg chen gyi kun rdzob tu 'gro ba yang yod/ gsang sngags las kyang*/ don dam sems skyed kha dog dang dbyibs su bsgom par bshad pa yang yod/ shū n+ya ta dang dngos po thams cad dang bral ba la sogs pa'i tshig gis/ stong pa sgom pa la don dam sems skyed du ming btags pa yang yod/ zla ba la kun rdzob/ rdo rje la don dam du ming btags pa sogs dpag med yod pas/ de dag gi rgyu mtshan legs par shes dgos/ gsang sngags kyi cho ga dang*/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i sems skyed bsres pas mi 'dre/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i smon 'jug la/ cho ga mdo bstan bcos kun nas bshad/ don dam sems skyed la cho ga mdo dang bstan bcos kun nas bshad pa med/ khyad par du dbu ma'i lugs/ slob dpon klu sgrub dang*/ slob dpon zhi ba lha'i spyod 'jug sogs las ma gsungs/ sems tsam pa'i slob dpon thogs med dang*/ sdom pa nyi shu pa dang*/ jo bo rje'i sems skyed kyi gzhung las kyang*/ don dam sems skyed la cho ga ma gsungs so// zhes 'byung ngo*// gsung 'di'i ngag don bsdus na/ gsang sngags las don dam sems skyed kyi cho ga bshad/ phar phyin theg pa las ma bshad cing*/ sngags su cho ga bshad pa'i don dam sems skyed de/ don dam sems skyed mtshan nyid pa ma yin/ zhes bya ba'i don no// gnyis pa rang lan go bde bar brjod pa la gnyis te/

mdo sngags kyi don dam byang sems kyi khyad par phye ba dang*/ lugs gnyis ka la don dam sems skyed bskyed pa'i cho ga yod du chug kyang*/ de'i stobs kyis skyes pa ma yin par bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ bka' gdams kyi bstan rim 'ga' zhig dang*/ rje phag mo gru pa'i don dam sems skyed kyi cho ga zhes bya ba'i yi ge las/ gong du drangs pa'i spang kong phyag rgya pa'i cho ga'i tshig de la rten pa'i sngags chog lan gsum brjod pa dang*/ mjug tu gzengs bstod pa dang*/ spro ba skyed pa'i tshig sbyar ba'i cho ga mdzad nas/ lugs de phar phyin theg pa'i dbang du byas par bzhed do// don de 'gog pa ni gzhung 'dir/ don dam sems skyed ces bya ba// bsgoms pa'i stobs kyis skye mod kyi// zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs so// de la spyir phar phyin theg par kun rdzob sems skyed ces bya ba/ sangs rgyas kyi gzhan don gyi sku dmigs yul du byas nas/ bsod nams kyi tshogs nyams su len pa dang*/ don dam pa'i sems skyed ces bya ba/ sangs rgyas kyi don dam pa'i sku la dmigs nas/ ye shes kyi tshogs nyams su len pa'o// de lta bu'i rnam par gzhag pa de sngags kyi theg par yang mi bzhed pa ni ma yin mod/ thun mong ma yin pa'i byang chub kyi sems gnyis ni/ ji skad du/ rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ kun rdzob don dam gzugs can gyi// byang chub sems ni rab tu skyed// kun rdzob kunda lta bu nyid// don dam bde ba'i gzugs can no// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ don dam pa byang chub kyi sems zhes kyang bya/ rang bzhin lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes zhes kyang bya/ mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba dang*/ dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje zhes kyang bya ba de/ thog mar rang gi rgyud la ji ltar gnas pa'i tshul ngos bzung ste/ sems de gsal btab pa'i sgo nas dam bca' tsam gyis skyed pa'i cho ga ni/ gong du rgyas par ji skad drangs pa de dag go

/'o na byang chub kyi sems de dus nam gyi tshe mngon du 'gyur pa yin zhe na/ rim pa gnyis kyi ting nge 'dzin bsgoms pa'i stobs kyis/ rang byung gi ye shes nam mngon du byas pa de'i tshe na'o// de yang mtshon byed dpe'i ye shes kyi tshe na rjes mthun pa dang*/ mtshon bya don gyi ye shes kyi tshe na de mtshan nyid pa mngon du gyur pa yin no// 'o na phar phyin theg pa'i don dam sems skyed dngos de dang*/ 'di'i khyad par ci zhe na/ gnyis ka yang theg chen mthong lam gyi dus su mngon du 'gyur bar mtshungs kyang*/ khyad par shin tu che ba yin te/ 'di ni yul can dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje dang*/ mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen pos/ yul spros pa'i mtha' bral rtogs pa yin pas/ phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes dngos yin la/ gcig shos la de med pa'i phyir ro// 'o na byang chub kyi sems de bzung ba'i cho ga lan gsum brjod pa'i mtha' de nyid du mi skye bar/ ji ltar bzung ba'i don de nyid la blo gzhag nas/ yun ring du bsgoms pa'i stobs kyis skye ba yin na/ brjod pa lan gsum la dgos pa med do// ce na/ mi 'gal te/ dper na rigs lnga'i sdom pa de bzung ba'i cho ga lan gsum pa'i mtha' de nyid du mi skye bar/ bsgoms pa'i stobs kyis bum dbang rdzogs pa'i mthar skye dgos pa bzhin no// de'i phyir/ don dam byang chub kyi sems de dgos pa gang gi phyir du skyed pa'i sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims de yang*/ sems skyed de dang lhan cig tu 'dzin pa dang mi 'dzin pa'i lugs gnyis las/ phyi ma ni gong du drangs pa'i lung phal che ba rnams kyis ston la/ lugs dang po ni byang chub sems 'grel nas 'byung ba'i cho ga des ston pa yin la/ 'di ni sngags kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i lugs te/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa nas/ byang chub kyi sems kyi rdo rje de gsal btab pa dang lhan cig tu/

sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims de 'dzin pa'i bshad pa med pa'i phyir ro// don de nyid ni rdo rje rtse mo las kyang 'byung ba yin te/ ji skad du/ byang chub sems ni bla med mchog /dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag gi sdom pa ma lus bzung*// zhes pas don de bstan pa'i phyir te/ smon 'jug dang de'i sdom pa gnyis ni/ gong du rnam snang gi dam tshig tu bzung zin pa'i phyir/ 'o na ci/ don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems 'di'i dbang du byas pa'i sdom pa ni de kho nar zad dam/ gzhan yang yod ce na/ gzhan ni nges par yod de/ de la don dam pa byang chub kyi sems kyi rdo rje de gsal btab nas gzung ba'i sdom pa dang*/ bzung ba de'i rgyun goms par byas pas mngon du gyur pa'i gnas skabs kyi sdom pa'o// dang po la gnyis te/ don dam byang sems kyi dam tshig la 'jug pa'i sdom pa dang*/ dam tshig de la gnas pa'i sdom pa'o// de gnyis len pa'i cho ga ni rnam snang mngon byang gi lung gong du drangs pa'i don tshan gnyis pa des go rim bzhin du bstan pa yin la/ dam tshig de'i ngo bo ni sems rang bzhin gyi chos skur mthong ba de nyid yin par ni/ mngon byang gi lung*/ ji skad du/ dam tshig gsum gang zhe na/ zhes sogs gong du drangs zin pa de nyid kyis ston zhing*/ de dang 'gal ba'i ltung ba yang*/ ji skad du/ lnga gang zhe na/ zhes sogs drangs zin pa de nyid do// gnyis pa don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems de nyid mngon du gyur pa'i gnas skabs kyi sdom pa de'i ngo bo dang*/ thob pa'i dus kyang ji skad du/ rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sdom pa ni// e waṃ rnam par yang dag gnas// e waṃ rnam pa bde chen po// dbang las yang dag shes par bya// zhes gsungs shing*/ de'i 'og tu de la ltos pa'i dam tshig rnams kyang gsungs so// 'o na 'dir/

gang zhig gang gis sdom zhe na/ spang bya bzung 'dzin gyi rnam par rtog pa rnams/ sdom byed gnyis med kyi ye shes mngon du gyur pa'i stobs kyis sdom la/ 'di la bla ma gong mas/ rdzogs rim gyi sdom pa zhes bya ba'i tha snyad btags pa de yin no// gnyis pa ni/ mdor na mdo sngags kyi don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems gnyis po don gcig gam mi gcig kyang rung*/ de len par byed pa'i cho ga sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims dang 'brel kyang rung ma 'brel kyang rung ste/ brjod pa khas blangs kyi dam bca' lan gsum byas pa'i mtha' de nyid du/ brjod pa de'i stobs las byang chub kyi sems 'di skye ba ni srid pa ma yin te/ yin na brda las byung ba'i sems skyed du thal ba'i phyir ro// de'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ 'di la sbyor dngos kyi cho ga gsungs kyang*/ rjes kyi cho ga bshad pa med do// rim pa lnga par bshad pa de ni/ dbang gsum pa'i dus su dpe'i ye shes skyes pa'i mtha' rten du yon 'bul ba'i tshig yin gyi/ don gyi ye shes mngon du byas pa'i rjes kyi cho ga ni ma yin pas/ der de bshad pa las byung ba'i nyes pa de yod pa ma yin no// don de la dgongs nas/ gzhung 'di nyid du/ 'di la sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi// cho ga rgyal bas gsungs pa med// ces par rjes shes bya ba'i tshig la nus pa 'don rgyu yin pa dang*/ thub pa'i dgongs pa gsal ba las kyang*/ blun po dag gis kyang chos nas bshad pa'i sde snod kyi rnam gzhag dang*/ dbang skur la sogs pa cho ga zab mo ma mthong bar/ ma bshad pa'i smon 'jug gi sems skyed la gsang sngags kyi lha sgom pa dang*/ don dam sems skyed la rjes brjod kyi cho ga byed pa sogs/ sangs rgyas kyis ma gsungs pa byed pa de dag bstan pa la gnod pa yin te/ mun pa mun nag tu mig mi gsal ba zhugs pa dang 'dra'o// zhes byams pas mdo sde rgyan las gsungs so// zhes bshad pa yin no// des na de 'dra de la rjes chog sbyar na/

bsgrub bya de 'phags pa nyid du khas blangs par song bas/ gnas 'di la bag yod par bya'o// de dag la 'di skad ces/ don dam byang sems zhes bya ba// mdo dang sngags kyi khyad par las// stong nyid mngon sum rtogs blo dang*// sems kyi rdo rje dag la bzhed// de bskyed pa yi sngags chog tsam// de thob byed pa'i thabs min kyang*// nges par 'byed pa'i cha bzhi dang*// dbang dang rim gnyis goms pas 'thob// ces sbyar ba yin no// //dri ba brgyad pa ni/ sarba yo ga tsitta sogs// slob mas bzlas te kun rdzob dang*// don dam sems skyed 'dzin bcug nas// su ra te sa ma zhes sogs kyis// skyes zin brtan par byed de ci// 'di la gnyis las/ dang po la/ 'dri ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ dkyil chog phyi ma mang po'i nang na/ sngags dang po de brjod pas byang chub tu sems skyed pa gzung la/ sngags phyi ma dang*/ rdo rje snying khar gzhag pas/ byang chub kyi sems de brtan par byed pa yin no// zhes gsung ba dag snang la/ de lta na don dam sems skyed la rjes kyi cho ga bshad par 'gyur ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis so// ma dris pa'i nyes pa ni/ brtag pa 'di nye bar ma bkod na/ thams cad rnal 'byor du sems skyed par bgyi'o// zhes pa'i sngags 'di don dam pa byang chub kyi sems skyed pa'i sngags su mi go bar snang ba dang*/ sngags 'di slob dpon rkyang pas brjod la/ slob mas ni/ snying khar byang chub kyi sems gnyis kyi ngo bo zla ba dang rdo rje sgom pa tsam yin gyi/ sngags de'i rjes zlos bya mi dgos par 'chad pa dang*/ thams cad ces pa'i tshig gis kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i sems gnyis ka 'dzin par 'khrul ba dang*/ su ra te zhes sogs sems skyed pa'i sngags dang*/ skyed zin brtan pa'i sngags su 'khrul pa gnyis ka 'dug pa dang*/ 'dir don dam pa byang chub kyi sems 'dzin par bshad pa de dang*/ rnam snang mngon byang du/

don dam pa byang chub kyi sems kyi dam tshig gnas pa'i sdom pa 'dzin par bshad pa gnyis po don gcig tu mi go ba'i nyes pa yod do// 'o na de dang de'i shes byed ci zhe na/ go rim bzhin du bshad pa ni/ dpal mchog las/ smon pa byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed zin pa'i rjes su/ sangs rgyas kyi rang bzhin rtogs pa'i byang chub kyi rang bzhin gyi sems skyed pa ni/ dang po kho nar de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gsang ba dam pa'i sngags lan gcig brjod pas bskyed du bcug ste/ zhes gsungs pa dang*/ dkyil chog rdo rje phreng ba las/ sngags 'di'i rjes bzlos slob mas byed dgos pa nyid du bshad pa dang*/ 'di la ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gsang chen dam pa zhes bshad pa dang*/ rnam snang mngon byang du/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam tshig chen po zhes bshad pa gnyis don gcig la 'du ba'i phyir dang*/ sarba zhes sogs kyi sngags 'di ni/ thams cad rnal 'byor zhes bya ba'i ming can/ ye shes kyi rdo rje de nyid skyed pa'i sngags yin gyi/ kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems ni sngar sta gon gyi skabs la sogs par bskyed zin pa de nyid kyis chog pa'i phyir dang*/ 'dir zla ba'i steng du rdo rje sgom par bshad pa de yang*/ zla bas ni sngar bskyed zin pa'i kun rdzob sems skyed de nyid mtshon pa yin gyi/ 'dir bskyed bya'i sems de mtshon pa ma yin pa'i phyir dang*/ rje btsun rtse mos/ dbang gi chu bo las/ ji skad du/ de nas slob ma'i snying khar dngos su rdo rje gzhag ste/ rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa 'od 'phro ba gcig slob dpon dang slob ma gnyis kas bsgoms la/ sarba yo ga tsitta utpa tā ya mi/ zhes brjod pas byang chub kyi sems bskyed la/ zhes gsungs pas/ zla ba sgom pa med mi rung du ma bshad do// su ra te zhes sogs ni/ sems skyed pa'i sngags su tshad ldan sus kyang mi 'chad cing*/

skyes zin brtan pa'i sngags su yang bshad na rigs pa ma yin gyi/ 'o na ci zhe na/ ji ltar skyed pa de nyid brtan par bzung nas gsang bar gdams pa'i sngags su rigs pa yin no// gnyis pa dngos lan gdab pa ni/ slob ma'i snying khar rdo rje bsgoms nas/ sngags kyi rjes bzlos byed du 'jug pa 'di ni/ don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems skyed pa'i cho ga yin te/ sngags lugs kyi byang chub kyi sems rdo rje zhes bya ba de gsal btab nas 'dzin pa'i cho ga yin pa'i phyir/ 'dir bzung ba'i dam tshig gi ngo bo ni/ gzung 'dzin gnyis su med pa'i ye shes de nyid/ rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bor gsal btab nas sems 'dzin par byed pa'o// phan yon gyi sgo nas dam la gzhag pa'i skabs su/ ye shes kyi rdo rje zhes gsungs pa yang 'di nyid la bsams pa yin te/ ji skad du/ dpal mchog las/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni// zhes pa nas/ dpal mchog gi dang po'i skyes bu'o// zhes pa'i bar du gsungs pas so// cho ga 'di tsam gyis byang chub kyi sems de skyes par ni mi 'jog ste/ de mngon du 'gyur ba'i nges pa med pa'i phyir te/ de mngon du 'gyur ba ni/ byang chub kyi sems ji lta ba de nyid kyi rigs rgyun goms par byas pa la ltos pa'i phyir/ dus nam gyi tshe mngon du 'gyur zhe na/ gang gi tshe theg pa chen po'i mthong ba'i lam mngon du byas pa de'i tshe na'o// de bas na/ thams cad rnal 'byor du sems skyed pa'i sngags tshig 'di la rjes kyi cho ga ni tshad ldan sus kyang ma bshad pa bzhin du ma sbyor te/ gzhan du na/ brda las byung ba'i sems skyed du thal ba'i rigs pa dang*/ 'di la sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi// cho ga rgyal bas gsungs pa med// ces bya ba'i lung dang 'gal bas so// de lta na'ang*/ 'dir don dam sems skyed skyes pa med kyang*/ sems de bzung ba'i dam tshig gi 'gal zla rnams ni nges par bsrung dgos te/

rgyud sde 'og ma gnyis su gsungs pa'i rtsa ltung rnams kyang 'di la ltos pa'i rtsa ltung du 'chad dgos pa'i phyir dang*/ ji skad du/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang*/ zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir ro// zhar la sems de bskyed pa'i dgos pa ci zhe na/ dkyil 'khor gyi nang du zhugs nas ye shes sems dpa' phebs sla ba dang*/ phebs zin pa na 'bras dus kyi rdo rje sems pa de nyid/ gzhi dus kyi rdo rje sems dpa' dang dbyer med du ngo 'phrod nas/ mi 'bral bar dus rtag du bzhugs pa'i dgos pa yod do// //dri ba dgu pa ni/ bdag gzhan brje ba mtha' gcig tu// nor chen chos shes phyogs snga mas// ji ltar khas blangs sa brgyad par// brje ba sgom par 'chad min nam// phyogs sngar sdug bsngal dang len gyi// bzod pa thob dang ma thob pa'i// zhib cha phye ba ma klags na// lung rigs chud 'dzar mi 'gyur ram// zhes pa 'di la gnyis las/ 'dri ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ 'di'i thad kyi rnam bshad mdzad pa kun gyis/ phyogs snga ma la zhib cha ji ltar yod kyi zur ma phyin par/ gzhung sbyar bde ba'i sgra ji bzhin pa de nyid thad sor bzhag pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis so// ma dris pa'i nyes pa ni/ rje 'bri khung pa'i gsung gis/ sa brgyad pa thob nas bdag gzhan brje ba sgom pa yin gyi// de ma thob pa de srid du/ gzhan gyi sdug bsngal blangs kyang mi bzod pas/ rdzogs byang gi lam sgrub pa'i bar chad du 'gyur pa yin te/ dper na/ shā ri'i bus dus min du mig sbyin par btang ba'i rkyen gyis nyan thos kyi sar lhung ba bzhin des na so so skye bo dang ma dag pa'i sar/ bde sdug gang byung kyang lam du 'khyer ba yin/ zhes gsung par 'dug pa de/ dag par ma klags na/ phyogs snga mas lan 'di ltar du thebs par 'gyur te/ ji skad du/ bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang chub sems// dge ba yin nam sdig yin brtag

/ces sogs la/ dge ba yin kyang dus min du// nyams su blangs na thabs mi mkhas// dus ma yin par yang dag mtha'// mngon du byas pa ji bzhin no// zhes dang*/ ji skad du/ byang chub sems dpa'i blo sbyong ba'i// smon lam 'ga' zhig mtha' mi btsan// gal te btsan na mdza' bo'i bu// rgyun du klad nad chen por 'gyur// zhes pa la/ mdza' bo'i bu yis sdug bsngal 'dis// gzhan gyis sdug bsngal dag gyur ces// lam du btang ba nyid yin gyi// gzhan gyi sdug bsngal blangs pa med// ces dang*/ ji skad du/ dus gsum sangs rgyas sras bcas kyang*// bdag gzhan brje ba bsgoms pa'i phyir// rgyun du sdug bsngal thob par 'gyur// zhes pa la/ mi skye'i chos la bzod thob nas// sdug bsngal dag gis gdung ba med// de ma thob par sdug bsngal na// rdzogs byang sgrub pa'i gegs su 'gyur// zhes pa dang*/ ji skad du/ brjes pa'i sems can de dag kun// sdug bsngal 'byung ba mi srid 'gyur// zhes pa la/ bdag gzhan brje ba nor chos su// khas blangs pa la rigs pa 'di// 'jug na bdag gzhan brje ba'i sems// byang chub lam du khas blangs sam// klu sgrub zhabs dang spyod 'jug gi /lung gis mi gnod bzod thob nas// brje ba sgom pa nyid la dgongs// zhes bya ba'i lan de dang de dag thebs pas/ rang lugs kyi lung rigs de dag chud za ba nyid du byed par 'gyur ro// gnyis pa dngos lan gdab pa ni/ phyogs snga ma na re/ rje phag po gru pa'i gsung gis/ kho bo sngon dad pa ni che/ shes rab ni chung bas/ rtag par gzhan gyi sdug bsngal rnams bdag la smin par gyur cig ces smon lam btab pas/ da lta rtag par zhabs snyung pa de des lan pa yin/ zhes gsung pas/ gzhan gyi sdug bsngal 'khur mi bzod pa so so skye bo dang*/ ma dag pa'i sa bdun tshun chad du rang gzhan brjes nas dag par 'gyur ba'i skabs yod do// zhes gsung ngo*// de dgag pa la/

rigs pa dang*/ lung gnyis las/ dang po la/ so so skye bos brje ba sgom pa'i sems mi dge bar thal ba dang*/ gnas ma yin pa'i smon lam mi srid par thal ba dang*/ sa brgyad pa yan chad du gzhan gyi sdug bsngal thams cad len par nus na/ gzhan la sdug bsngal 'byung mi srid par thal ba dang*/ bdag gi bde ba gzhan la 'pho nus na/ gzhan 'bad med du grol bar thal ba dang*/ rang grol ba mi srid par thal ba rnams 'jug go /rgyun du sdug bsngal thob par 'gyur// zhes pa'i don yang*/ sdug bsngal gyis gdung bar thal ba'i don ma yin gyi/ gzhan gyi sdug bsngal rang rgyud la thob par thal ba'i don yin la/ de 'dod na/ brjes pa'i sems can de dag kun// zhes sogs 'phen no// gnyis pa ni/ rin chen phreng ba dang*/ spyod 'jug gi don yang*/ byang sems so skye'i dbang du byas pa yin te/ rin chen phreng bar/ gzhan gyi sdig pa bdag la smin par smon lam btab pa/ theg chen 'phags pa ni sdig pa'i rnam par smin pa smin pa'i rten du mi rung ba'i phyir dang*/ spyod 'jug gi lung gi don yang*/ bdag gzhan brje ba ma byas na/ las nyon gyi dbang gis 'khor bar skye rung zhig gi rten gyi dbang du mdzad par gsal ba'i phyir ro// //dri ba bcu pa ni/ nyan thos rnams kyi rdzogs byang du// bsngo ba byed na 'phags pa yis// nyan thos theg pa de las ni// spyod pa yongs bsngo ma bshad ces// bya ba'i dgongs pa gang du btsal// zhes pa'o// 'di la gnyis las/ dang po la 'dri dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ gzhung gi dngos bstan la/ stong pa nyid kyi lta ba dang*/ dge ba'i rtsa ba rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo ba ni nyan thos la'ang yod mod/ de lta na'ang*/ bdag gzhan brje ba'i lam med pas/ nyan thos kyi lam gyis 'tshang rgya bar mi nus so// zhes bya ba'i don du 'chad pa po mang ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis so// gnyis pa ma dris pa'i skyon ni/ nyan thos kyi sde snod las dge rtsa rdzogs byang du bsngo bar bshad pa de/

nyan thos kyi theg pa'i dbang du byas par bzhed dam/ byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa'i dbang du byas par bzhed/ dang po ltar na/ rin po che'i phreng ba las/ nyan thos theg pa de las ni// byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam dang*// spyod pa yongs bsngo ma bshad de// byang chub sems dpar ga la 'gyur// zhes bya ba'i lung dang ma mthun pa dang*/ nyan thos kyi theg pa par nges pa rnams ni/ rang gis bsags pa'i dge rtsa rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo ba don med do// zhes bya ba'i rigs pas gnod pa ma yin nam/ gnyis pa ltar na/ nyan thos kyi lam du byang chub sems dpa'i sems skyed kyi bslab byar gyur pa'i bdag gzhan brje ba ma bstan zhes par song bas/ nyan thos kyi sde snod du/ byang chub sems dpas bdag las gzhan gces par bzung ba'i skyes pa rabs kyi sde tshan mang du gsungs pa rnams dang 'gal te/ dper na/ 'dul ba'i lung du byang chub sems dpa'i skyes rabs mang du gsungs pa bzhin no// gnyis pa dngos lan gdab pa la/ rin chen phreng ba'i lung don bshad pa dang*/ de dang so thar gyi mdo'i bsngo ba mi 'gal ba'i tshul lo// dang po ni/ lung de'i don nyan thos kyi theg pa pa nyid kyi dbang du byas pa yin te/ byang chub sems dpar ga la 'gyur// zhes pa'i lung dang 'brel pas so// de yang*/ yongs bsngo zhes pa smon sems dang*/ spyod pa zhes pas 'jug sdom dang*/ smon lam zhes pa gzugs sku gnyis las gzhan don 'bad med lhun grub tu 'byung ba'i smon lam 'debs pa rnams/ gnas skabs nyan thos kyi theg par rigs nges pa rnams la med pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpar mi 'jog ces bya ba'i don no// gnyis pa ni/ so thar gyi mdo las/ so sor thar pa bton pa yi// dge ba grub pa gang yod pa// des ni 'gro ba ma lus pa// thub dbang go 'phang thob par shog /ces gsungs pa de ni/ rin chen phreng bar bshad ma thag pa'i bsngo ba de dang don gcig pa ma yin te/

de ni yan lag bdun pa'i bzlas phye ba'i bsngo ba'i ming can/ smon pa byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa de yin la/ 'di ni 'gro ba gzhan thams cad kyis thub dbang gi go 'phang thob par smon lam 'debs pa yin pas so// yang na/ nyan thos kyi sde snod du byang chub sems dpa'i lam gyi rnam gzhag ston pa na/ stong pa nyid kyi lta ba dang*/ smon pa sems skyed tsam bstan kyang*/ 'jug pa sems skyed kyi bslab bya rdzogs par bstan pa med pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ nyan thos kyi sde snod du rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi lam cha tshang ba ma bstan par 'chad dgos pa yin te/ nyan thos kyi sde snod du chos kyi bdag med bstan na/ theg pa chen po bstan pa don med du thal ba'i rtsod lan du/ slob dpon zla ba grags pas/ rin chen phreng ba'i lung snga ma de drangs pas so// gzhung 'di'i phyogs snga mkhan po ltar na/ nyan thos kyi sde snod du sangs rgyas kyi lam cha tshang ba zhig bstan par thal/ der stong nyid kyi lta ba dang smon sems ni bstan/ 'jug sdom gyi bslab bya'i gtso bo bdag gzhan brje ba ni/ ji srid sa brgyad pa mngon du ma byas pa de srid du sgom du mi rung ba'i phyir/ 'dod na theg pa chen po bkar sgrub pa'i gsung gi tshogs dang 'gal lo// zhes bya ba'i don to// //dri ba bcu gcig pa ni/ thams cad sgrol gyi skyes rabs las// bdag gis bram ze 'dod pa la// zhes sogs bsngo ba bshad pa de// nyan thos bsngo ba yin bzhed dam// zhes pa 'di la gnyis las/ dang po la 'dri ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ ji skad du/ de sogs bsngo ba'ang mang du gsungs// 'on kyang thabs la mkhas pa yi// khyad par 'ga' zhig ma gsungs pas// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sgrub mi nus// zhes pa'i dngos bstan/ nyan thos la stong nyid kyi lta ba dang*/ dge rtsa rdzogs byang du bsngo ba yod pa'i shes byed du/ thams cad sgrol gyi skyes rabs kyi lung de drangs nas/

'on kyang bdag gzhan brje ba'i lam med pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub sgrub mi nus so zhes bya ba'i don du bshad pa lta bur snang ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis so// gnyis pa ma dris na gzhung chud 'dza' ba'i skyon ni/ de lta na ji skad du/ bdag gis bram ze 'dod pa la// dga' bas shing rta 'di btang bas// dngos po thams cad btang nas ni// rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par shog /ces pa'i smon lam 'di nyan thos kyi theg pa pas btab pa'i smon lam du 'gyur ro// de 'dod na byang chub sems dpa'i skyes rabs su bshad pa dang 'gal lo// snyam pa'i dogs pa 'di 'byung ngo*// gnyis pa dngos lan ni/ snga ma bzhin du lta bar bya ste/ 'di byang chub sems dpas btab pa'i smon lam yin kyang*/ de gang du 'byung ba ni nyan thos kyi sde snod yin la/ de'i tshe na 'di ltar/ nyan thos kyi sde snod las kyang byang chub sems dpa'i thabs kyi cha tshang bar bstan pa nyid du thal bar 'gyur te/ der smon pa sems skyed ni drangs ma thag pa'i lung gis bstan la/ 'jug sdom gyi bslab bya'i gtso bo bdag gzhan brje ba ni/ ji srid sa brgyad pa mngon du ma byas pa de srid du byang chub sems dpa'i lam du mi 'gyur ba'i phyir ro// de 'dod na/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i phyogs rlabs po che ma lus pa bde blag tu rtogs pa'i ched du/ theg pa chen po bstan pa don med par 'gyur ro// yang skabs 'dir/ dris lan 'di lta bu zhig kyang 'jug ste/ nyan thos stong pa nyid sgom na// chos nyid mngon sum rtogs par 'gyur// 'dod na thub pa'i dgongs gsal dang*// 'gal bar 'gyur ba ma yin nam// chos nyid stong nyid de bzhin nyid// nyi tshe ba tsam de yis rtogs// gnyis med ye shes rang stong du// des ni rtogs pa chos 'di'i lugs// des de dad pas rtogs nas ni// byang sems rnams la ston pa yod// 'on kyang shes bya'i sgrib pa yi// gnyen por des de sgom pa med// 'dzin pa chos kyi bdag bkag pa// kho na stong nyid ngos 'dzin du// 'chad pa zla ba grags pa'i gzhung*// gzhan rnams bdag med tsam la 'chad// zhes bya ba 'di yang nges par sbyar ba yin no// mang thos glang chen rigs pa'i mche ba can// rtog dpyod sna zhags lag pa ring rkyong ba// 'ga' zhig yod dam rgal lan gting zab pa'i// legs bshad khrus kyi 'jug ngogs 'dir zhugs shig

/yid bzhin rin chen nya pa'i lag dag tu// 'khyams pa ji bzhin mkhas pa'i gzhung lugs mchog /gsung rab don la byis pa'i blo ldan gyis// brgam por bcos pa'i lag pas chud gson pa// ma bzod rtog dpyod rgal lan brgya phrag gi /sbyong tshul rim gsum ldan pas de sbyangs nas// rnam dpyod rgyal mtshan rtse mor 'di bkod kyi// chos 'dod mang po'i re ba de skongs shig /ces sdom pa gsum gyi rab tu dbye ba zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos kyi byang sems kyi sdom pa'i skabs las brtsams pa'i 'bel gtam rnam par nges pa/ legs bshad gser gyi thur ma zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos kyi rim par phye ba gnyis pa'o// // ༄/ swasti/ gangs can ljongs su chos las gzhan// smra rnams pham mdzad bstan bcos kyi// 'grel mdzad snga mas ma dpyad pa'i// dka' ba'i gnas rnams 'dir dpyad pa// rang rang 'khor du tshangs pa bzhin// rlom byed rnam bshad gzhan mang po// rgyu skar tshogs 'ga' nyin byed kyi// drung du lhags pa bzhin min nam// gang 'di'i glegs bam mang por ni// cig char 'pho ba'i sgyu 'phrul gyi// bdag rkyen 'byor tshogs sa skyong pa// bkra shis skye rgu'i mgon gyis te// de yi rnam dkar gnas skabs su// srid zhi'i dgra las rnam rgyal nas// mthar thug chos kyi rgyal po yi// go 'phang mthon po der spyon shig/ //maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
